prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a clean character turnaround model sheet based on the supplied pixel-art spritesheet as CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PROPORTION REFERENCE, not as a layout to reproduce.
Exactly THREE full-body drawings of the SAME young adult woman, left to right: straight FRONT view, strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, straight BACK view. Neutral standing A-pose in every view: arms slightly separated from torso, relaxed empty hands, legs naturally straight, bare feet flat on the same invisible ground baseline. No perspective or three-quarter views. Precisely identical character height and anatomy proportions in all views, matching crown, chin, shoulders, waist and soles horizontally. Generous even spacing and margins.
Preserve the reference character's compact CHIBI proportions: large head, short compact torso, short substantial legs, approximately 2.5 to 3 heads tall overall; do not elongate into realistic fashion-figure proportions. She is an adult woman represented with stylized chibi anatomy.
Identity: very long, thick, voluminous flowing RED hair reaching the waist, broad soft locks framing the face and a full mass of hair at the back; warm tanned skin; simple LIGHT BLUE two-piece swimsuit matching the reference, turquoise-light-blue top and matching bottoms; barefoot; empty hands. Same hairline, facial design, swimsuit construction, colors and limb volumes in all three views. Natural neutral expression. Side profile must accurately rotate the same body and head; hair remains waist length from every angle.
Rendering: polished 2D concept art, smooth clean dark outlines, flat colors with simple clearly bounded cel shading, readable large shapes. Not pixelated, not photorealistic, no gradients or elaborate rendering. Uniform solid light gray background.
No text, labels, typography, logos, grids, borders, visible ground line, objects, accessories, dynamic poses, effects, scenery or cast shadows. Only these three views, complete from hair to toes. Landscape sheet.

Revise this character turnaround concept sheet, using the original pixel spritesheet as the proportion reference. Keep the SAME adult red-haired woman, exact same light blue two-piece swimwear, tan skin, clean cel-shaded illustration style and three-view layout: FRONT / strict RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE / BACK. Important correction: the current concept has legs and torso TOO LONG. Match the compact chibi proportions of the original sprite: approximately 2.25 HEADS TALL total, markedly larger head relative to body, a short compact torso, SHORT substantial thighs and calves with clear knees and bare feet. Legs from hip to sole should be only about 28 percent of total height. Do not just squash the whole drawing: redraw the anatomy as compact chibi. Keep adult character identity, neutral technical presentation. Hair very long and voluminous RED, ending at WAIST level in all views, not lower hips or knees. Same height, head size, body widths and limb lengths across the three rotated views; crowns, chins, shoulders, waists and soles all align. Neutral A-pose, arms slightly away from body, empty relaxed hands, legs straight, no dynamic movement. Full body uncropped. Clean contour linework, FLAT COLORS and simple two-tone CEL SHADING only, no gradients or airbrush. Entire background must be ONE uniform flat LIGHT GRAY color, no texture, no lighting gradient, no cast shadows, no floor line. Exactly three figures with even spacing. No text, props, effects, labels or accessories. Image 1 is the concept to correct; image 2 is original sprite proportion/identity reference.

boyfriend.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the BOYFRIEND character turnaround for the SAME GAME and SAME ARTIST as the two supplied reference sheets.
Input image 1: Player turnaround, strict reference for illustration style, head/body proportions, eye design, outline weight, shading, canvas/background and front/profile/back layout.
Input image 2: Enemy turnaround, reinforces the exact same visual language. Do not include either woman in the output.
Output one landscape 1536x1024 sheet showing exactly THREE full-body views of the SAME adult man, left to right straight FRONT, strict SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT, straight BACK. All views at identical scale, all crowns/chins/waists/knees/soles aligned. Relaxed neutral A-pose just like references: arms slightly away from sides, hands empty, feet bare, legs naturally straight. Full bodies entirely visible, generous spacing. Keep the same light gray background and comparable margins as the reference sheets. No labels, no typography, no props, no borders.
CRITICAL STYLE: match these reference illustrations in every respect: large chibi head, compact adult body, short substantial limbs, large expressive eyes, clean dark warm-brown contour, simple polished cel shading, restrained soft shading only to the same extent as reference. No photorealism, no 3D render, no pixelation, no painterly textures, no tiny realistic hair strands. This is an adult male counterpart who belongs next to these exact women, not a tall realistic fashion man. Only slightly taller than women (roughly 5-8% at equal head scale), with same large relative head; achieve through modest extra torso/leg length. Strong athletic well-built body, broad shoulders, solid arms and legs, moderately defined pecs and abdomen, neither skinny nor bulky bodybuilder. Gentle readable muscle contours, not heavily etched anatomy.
FACE: very handsome and charming adult man with confident friendly subtle smile, masculine but soft readable face, bright GREEN eyes rendered in the same large style as the women's eyes. Skin moderately sun-tanned warm golden beige, slightly lighter and less orange than the women.
HAIR: DARK BROWN, short classic neat cut, closely tapered sides and back, slightly longer top swept gently to the side, understated side part and modest volume, inspired ONLY by George Clooney's current classic short haircut shape; NOT gray, no celebrity likeness or older face. Hair must remain compact.
BEARD: dark brown, neat short close-cropped beard covering lower cheeks, entire jawline and chin, connected to short sideburns; tidy short mustache. Precisely shaped area below LOWER lip: a visible bare-skin gap between lower lip and chin beard, containing one small isolated triangular soul patch pointing DOWN. Keep visible bare skin on both sides of triangle and between its tip and main chin beard. Not a long pointed goatee. Interpret user Can Yaman reference ONLY as beard grooming inspiration, not face likeness. Render beard in clean cel-shaded blocks, consistent all views.
CLOTHING: bare torso, plain TERRACOTTA / warm brick-red swim BERMUDA boardshorts (base #B85B41, warm rust shadows, muted coral highlights). Hem ends halfway down the KNEECAP, NOT mid-thigh and not below knee. Relaxed straight leg fit, simple waistband and small cream drawstring, subtle seam/pocket lines only. No patterns/logos/large stripes.
ACCESSORY: one SMALL thin beach bead necklace fitting close around base of neck, tiny dark wood beads with a few understated red/gold-yellow/green accent beads for Jamaican-inspired beach styling. No large pendant, no thick chain, no other jewelry or accessories.
Ensure exact identity, beard geometry, hairstyle, shorts length/color and necklace continuity in all three rotations. Neutral technical character concept, same attractive compact cartoon adult style and exact presentation as references.
